source: synthetic: ten callback-style handlers to move to async/await on db.promises
prompt: Migrate every handler in src/handlers/ from the callback style to async functions, as README.md describes: each takes only the request, returns a Promise of its result, throws HttpError where it called done(err), and uses db.promises instead of db's callback API. Behaviour must not change. Do not change the tests. Run `bun test` until it passes.
